svg.title: A complete pressure and valve consistency trace
svg.desc: Old pressures12 and4mmHg become a rejected closed candidate24 and3 after compliance changes. The consistent open candidate gives14.6667 and5.3333. Both candidates conserve0.36L, so conservation alone cannot select the valve state.
